verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly shows that Missive has its own "AI rules" alongside the assistant, mentioned in passing in a credentials changelog note. The session tab, which shows what the assistant is doing, gives some auditability. No first-party documentation describes AI auto-labeling, categorization, or attention-surfacing, and the CRM-triage line is a hypothetical example for external MCP agents, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented AI auto-labeling/categorization, AI prioritization or surfacing of what needs attention, controls for steering triage behavior, an audit trail specific to AI triage decisions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
Long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting. The session tab now shows what the assistant is up to
a conversation links back to the sessions attached to it.
